fields.title: 📖 Zuhd between gratitude and patience
fields.body:
🖋️ **Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah** was asked: “What is zuhd in the dunyā?” He said:

> ***“When Allah grants him a favor, he is grateful; and when he is tried with an affliction, he is patient — that is zuhd.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True **zuhd** is not only poverty or outward simplicity. It shows itself in that the heart does not become arrogant at a **favor** and does not collapse at a **trial**: ***shukr in blessing and ṣabr in trial.***

immutable.source: 📝 Abū Nuʿaym, Ḥilyat al-Awliyāʾ wa Ṭabaqāt al-Aṣfiyāʾ, Kapitel: Suʾāl Aṣḥāb Sufyān lahu ʿan az-Zuhd wa Ifādatihim ʿan az-Zuhd, Band 7, S. 285.
